text:
Oncall Bot: ALER T: prod.gateway.redwood.ai - elevated 5xx rate and TLS handshake failures detected. 5xx spike at 03:02 UTC. Pager duty: @oncall-team P1. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/alerts/ALERT-9423
Jordan (oncall): acknowledged, taking. Investigating TLS errors + gateway 502/524s.
Sam (infra): seeing a bunch of `TLS handshake` in the gateway logs and upstream connection errors. Attaching a snippet: 
```
2026-03-14T03:02:10Z gateway[lb-1] ERROR connection handshake failed: tls: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
2026-03-14T03:02:11Z gateway[lb-2] WARN upstream failed: EOF
2026-03-14T03:02:12Z gateway[lb-1] ERROR http: proxy error: upstream handshake error
```
Priya (sre): do we know which certificate? mTLS between LB and backend or the public TLS?
Jordan (oncall): initial look: failures are at ingress -> backend service layer (gateway -> model-backend). Could be the cert used by the backend service. Checking cert dates with openssl now.
Sam (infra): I ran `openssl s_client -connect model-backend.internal:443 -servername model-backend.internal -showcerts` and got: 
```
subject=CN=model-backend.internal
issuer=CN=internal-ca
notBefore=Mar 10 02:00:00 2025 GMT
notAfter=Mar 13 02:00:00 2026 GMT
```
Sam (infra): looks expired yesterday (notAfter 2026-03-13). That matches the error window.
Emily (support): this started triggering customer complaints ~03:05 UTC. We have 3 active support tickets referencing 502/gateway errors; 2 are enterprise customers on Dedicated. Marking customer impact: high for a subset.
Priya (sre): likely root cause: internal mTLS cert for model-backend expired; gateways can't complete handshake so proxy returns 502/524. Immediate mitigation options: rotate cert, restart backend pods after updating secret, or temporarily disable mTLS to restore traffic while we rotate. Need decision.
Jordan (oncall): quick impact assessment: 15% of requests are failing, error budget at risk. Traffic routing shows european region hit worst. PagerDuty escalation notes sent.
PagerDuty Bot: Escalation: paging @sre-lead and @infra-lead per PD policy.
Sam (infra): I can generate a replacement cert from Vault CA now. Steps: 1) request cert 2) kubectl create secret tls model-backend-tls -n prod --key key.pem --cert cert.pem 3) rollout restart deploy/model-backend -n prod
Jordan (oncall): do we have the private key and CA in Vault?
Sam (infra): yes, using `vault write pki/issue/internal-ca common_name=model-backend.internal ttl=8760h` to issue a cert. I'll do that.
Priya (sre): while Sam issues the cert, I'm going to prepare a temp routing rule to send new requests to a healthy fallback pool to reduce errors. Also prepping a runbook note for disabling mTLS if we need a fast fallback.
Sam (infra): issued cert, uploading secret now. Commands I'm running: 
```
vault write -format=json pki/issue/internal-ca common_name="model-backend.internal" ttl="24h" > /tmp/newcert.json
jq -r .data.certificate /tmp/newcert.json > cert.pem
jq -r .data.private_key /tmp/newcert.json > key.pem
kubectl create secret tls model-backend-tls -n prod --cert=cert.pem --key=key.pem --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-backend -n prod
```
Jordan (oncall): proceeding with secret apply. Priya, coordinate routing update. Emily, please prepare customer comms draft in case outage extends beyond 15m.
Emily (support): on it. Drafting short note: "We are investigating intermittent 502/gateway errors affecting a subset of requests. Root cause: expired internal certificate for backend services. Engineers are rotating the cert now. ETA 15-30 minutes. We'll update in 15 minutes."
Priya (sre): Rolling restart triggered. Watching logs.
Sam (infra): logs show new cert loaded by pod model-backend-7b9f. Handshake errors dropping on lb-1.
Jordan (oncall): metrics: 5xx rate down from 15% to 2% over 90s. Latency stable.
Oncall Bot: Status update posted to #incidents. Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-14-9423
Emily (support): posting to customers with ETA update.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident acknowledged by Jordan. No further escalation required.
Priya (sre): verifying mTLS mutual auth since we re-used internal CA. I see successful mutual auth handshakes in gateway logs now: 
```
2026-03-14T03:06:42Z gateway[lb-1] INFO handshake complete: subject=CN=model-backend.internal, verified=true
```
Jordan (oncall): can we confirm all regions? Europe still has a small blip. Checking cluster in eu-prod.
Sam (infra): eu cluster had one pod still on old secret. Deleting it and letting deployment recreate.
Sam (infra): pod recreated, cert loaded. EU errors resolved. 5xx back to baseline ~0.5%.
Emily (support): updating customer tickets: "We rotated an internal certificate that had expired and restored service. We're monitoring; please reopen if you still see errors."
Jordan (oncall): moving to postmortem and runbook updates. Action items: 1) Add cert expiry alert for internal CA certs (currently only public certs alert) 2) Automate cert rotation via cert-manager/Vault with a 7d renew window 3) Communicate to Dedicated customers that incident impacted a small subset and was mitigated within ~10 minutes after start of rotation.
Priya (sre): logging action items in incident tracker. Assigning to Sam for automation and to Jordan for runbook update.
Oncall Bot: Incident resolved in status dashboard. Resolution note: rotated expired internal certificate for model-backend, restarted pods, traffic restored. Postmortem scheduled.
Jordan (oncall): thanks all. Closing thread after PM notes. :white_check_mark:
